title: Alorese language
extract: Alorese is an Austronesian language spoken by the Alorese people on Alor and the neighboring islands of the Alor Archipelago in eastern Indonesia. It is not to be confused with non-Austronesian (Papuan) languages of the Alor–Pantar family which are also spoken in this region. It is also distinct from Alor Malay, a Malay-based creole variety which is currently supplanting Alorese as the language of wider communication in the region.
